title: 中国哲学（一）：孔子的思想
subtitle: Chinese Philosophy I · The Thought of Confucius

cards.example: 孔子是伟大的思想家。
cards.exampleTranslation: Confucius was a great thinker.

cards.example: 他也是一位政治家。
cards.exampleTranslation: He was also a statesman.

cards.example: 孔子是著名的教育家。
cards.exampleTranslation: Confucius was a famous educator.

cards.example: 孔子创立了儒家学派。
cards.exampleTranslation: Confucius founded the Confucian school.

cards.example: 孔子提出了仁爱的主张。
cards.exampleTranslation: Confucius proposed the idea of benevolence.

cards.example: 孔子说仁就是爱人。
cards.exampleTranslation: Confucius said benevolence means loving others.

cards.example: 忠恕是孔子的重要思想。
cards.exampleTranslation: Zhongshu is an important Confucian idea.

cards.pinyin: jǐ suǒ bù yù, wù shī yú rén
cards.back: Do not impose on others what you do not want yourself.
cards.example: 这句话体现了忠恕之道。
cards.exampleTranslation: This sentence reflects the way of zhongshu.

cards.front: 己欲立而立人，己欲达而达人
cards.pinyin: jǐ yù lì ér lì rén, jǐ yù dá ér dá rén
cards.back: Help others establish themselves and succeed as you wish for yourself.
cards.example: 孔子强调要先人后己。
cards.exampleTranslation: Confucius emphasized helping others as you help yourself.

cards.back: restrain oneself and return to propriety
cards.example: 克己复礼强调道德自律。
cards.exampleTranslation: Kejifuli emphasizes moral self-discipline.

cards.example: 复礼就是遵守社会规范。
cards.exampleTranslation: Returning to ritual means following social norms.

cards.example: 按孔子的教导去做，可以成为道德高尚的人。
cards.exampleTranslation: Following Confucius's teaching can make one morally noble.

cards.example: 孔子第一个开办私学。
cards.exampleTranslation: Confucius was the first to open private schools.

cards.back: learning belonged to government schools (old system)
cards.example: 古代教育曾经学在官府。
cards.exampleTranslation: In ancient times, education was once monopolized by official schools.

cards.back: education for all, without social distinction
cards.example: 孔子主张有教无类。
cards.exampleTranslation: Confucius advocated education for everyone.

cards.example: 他不分贵贱贫富收学生。
cards.exampleTranslation: He accepted students regardless of social rank or wealth.

cards.back: the Greatest Sage and First Teacher
cards.example: 后人称孔子为至圣先师。
cards.exampleTranslation: Later generations called Confucius the Greatest Sage and First Teacher.

cards.example: 孔子弟子把他的言论编成《论语》。
cards.exampleTranslation: Confucius's disciples compiled his sayings into The Analects.

cards.example: 孔子晚年整理了六经。
cards.exampleTranslation: In his later years, Confucius organized the Six Classics.

cards.example: 孔子曾周游列国推行主张。
cards.exampleTranslation: Confucius traveled among states to promote his political ideas.
